liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Days Between** (1 review): Considered one of Garcia and Hunter's finest compositions since the 1970s [6]

## The recordings

- **gd93-02-10.rehearsal.Samaritano.17435.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): source not stated; 2 songs; 25 min; rated 4/5 by 20 [1]. Said about its sound: Recording quality is good, though Jerry's vocal performance is described as poor; Jerry's 1990s voice had a rustic quality when healthy and mostly in tune [2][8]

## Around the show

- Mickey's aggressive drumming confused the rehearsal vibe, while Vince sounded good on pads [3]
- Jerry guided Vince on arpeggios and pads for the slower tunes [3]
- Jerry was no longer healthy in 1993, with his death occurring two years later [6]
- The song's slow pace, similar to High Time, was poorly received in live shows [4]
- Jerry's performance here is appealing, contrasting with his often weak live vocals [8]
- The second take of the song is comparatively more polished than the first [12]
- Listed alongside So Many Roads and Touch of Gray as superior Hunter/Garcia songs [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd93-02-10.rehearsal.Samaritano.17435.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD->CD->EAC->SHN [1]
